actor_instance: MFM author's owner-controlled local scratch reproduction and separate hash/count verification reported to FBM
goal: Record a deterministic synthetic source-only review intake rehearsal as a reproducible FBM procedure without manufacturing formation targets or data admission.
procedure: Reproduce 480 synthetic host histories for 30 days from the pinned generator, pin the 3,843-file source inventory, build 1/7/15/30-day source-only packet windows, and run the source-reconstructing private annotation draft intake. Independently rehash inventory, packet and draft artifacts in local scratch; parse row/host/packet/anchor/unknown counts and inspect file modes. Keep raw packets and private drafts out of FBM Git.
decision_criteria: 480 synthetic personas, 30 days, 3843 pre-inventory files totaling 75359948 bytes; inventory SHA-256 a5fcd53f84e049f84a2aaf0e1902da17a2d9d8fd4eec85deccb4bf8902c4d362
1920 source packets for day 1/7/15/30 totaling 92817429 bytes; SHA-256 4ae868b2cae39b837364f71c8b68cebe5fee731bca3711e1459d87782084e642
1920 drafts totaling 46153607 bytes; SHA-256 b43a8d290b07127d6ccc7204016f6aea6bb890caf996c40bf7430bda709b7c5e; draft mode 0600
independent local sha256sum and parse confirmed exact three digests, 1920 packet rows, 1920 draft rows, 480 unique hosts, 1920 unique packet IDs, 102240 anchors and 19200 unknown review states
source packet file mode 0644 in owner-controlled local scratch
authority: Owner-side local synthetic data and independently checked hashes/counts show procedure reproducibility only. The single generator cannot support generator-disjoint validation; the drafts carry no formed memory target, original-file byte-offset review, authenticated rights, two independent blind reviewers, train/DEV/FINAL assignment or optimizer authority.
validation: MFM author separately ran sha256sum over the local inventory, packets and drafts and parsed exact counts and file modes. FBM checkout contains only metadata and did not independently mount owner scratch or inspect raw case content.
failure_or_lesson: A large reproducible packet and draft count is useful review infrastructure but has no supervised formation labels or independent evaluation authority. Keep provenance hashes, source text, original byte anchors, rights, reviewers and split custody distinct; never infer gold from generated volume.
